item.title: Berlinan 1.3.0
item.description:
• CC LFO editor: click ∿ ＋ under a voice name to add an LFO that slowly moves a synth control (default CC 74, the filter on many synths). Shape, cycle (1–64 bars), Min/Max range, depth and phase are set in a strip under the voice lane; changes are heard at once, also while playing, and are saved with the project. Up to four LFOs per voice.
  • Parameter list: the magnifier next to the CC number opens more than 400 synths and effects from midi.guide (manufacturer › model › parameter, with search). Data: midi.guide, CC BY-SA 4.0.
  • The lane menu's CC Profile item is gone; the parameter list replaces it.
